_comment: Area-control (CTR/ACC) frequencies, used together with the CENTER frequencies in the sim's airport data. Each entry: { "name": "Madrid Control", "frequencyMhz": 133.100, "latitude": 40.0, "longitude": -3.7 } where the position is a point inside the sector the frequency serves. Fill in from a source you trust; values here are never invented. Empty: flights without sim CENTER data go straight from Departure to Approach.
